steps.journalDescription: Kastor has removed the first obstacle on the path to rescuing Dibber. I should speak to him again farther inside the rubble.
The path is blocked by some bats. I should approach and slay them to progress through the rubble
I should speak to Kastor again farther inside the rubble.
Use the Crank next to the unfinished shack in the northwest corner of the camp.
I should speak to Kastor again farther inside the rubble.
Have two Party Members stand on each of the buttons to clear the rubble.
I should speak to Kastor again farther inside the rubble.
Remove the wall patch between Kastor and Dibber to progress further through the rubble.
I should speak to Dibber to let him know he is safe.
I rescued Dibber, but he's very hurt. It is yet to be seen if he will recover.
